resource.title: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Single-blinded, Randomized Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics and Safety of Sotatercept (MK-7962) Administered Using Either a Weight-based or Weight-banded Approach in Participants With Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) on Standard of Care
resource.description:
Researchers are looking for other ways to treat people with PAH. In PAH, the blood vessels in the lungs become thick and narrow, which makes it harder for blood to flow to the lungs.

The goal of the study is to learn:

* What happens to different doses of sotatercept in a person's body over time when it is given using weight-banded doses compared to weight-based doses. There may be differences in how the medicine works with the new dosing method (weight-banded dosing) being studied in this trial.
* About the safety of sotatercept and if people tolerate it

extension.valueString:
1. Ocena ekspozycji ogólnoustrojowej na sotatercept w stanie stacjonarnym z zastosowaniem dawkowania opartego na masie ciała w stosunku do ekspozycji z zastosowaniem dawkowania opartego na masie ciała po podaniu dawek wielokrotnych (dawek podtrzymujących) w stanie stacjonarnym.
2. Ocena bezpieczeństwa i tolerancji sotaterceptu w ciągu 24 tygodni leczenia.

1. Evaluar la exposición sistémica en el estado de equilibrio de sotatercept mediante la administración de dosis basada en rangos de peso en relación con la exposición, mediante la administración de dosis basada en el peso después de la administración de dosis múltiples (dosis de mantenimiento) en el estado de equilibrio
2. Evaluar la seguridad y tolerabilidad de sotatercept durante 24 semanas de tratamiento

1. Evaluatie van de systemische steady-stateblootstelling aan sotatercept bij dosering op basis van een gewichtsbereik in vergelijking met dosering op basis van het gewicht na toediening van meerdere doses (onderhoudsdoses) bij een steady state.
2. Evaluatie van de veiligheid en verdraagzaamheid van sotatercept tijdens een behandeling van 24 weken

1. A sotatercept egyensúlyi állapotú szisztémás expozíciójának értékelése súlysávos adagolás esetén a súlyalapú adagolás esetén tapasztalt expozícióhoz képest több (fenntartó dózisok) dózis egyensúlyi állapotban történő adagolása után.
2. A sotatercept biztonságosságának és tolerálhatóságának értékelése 24 hét kezelés során

1. Évaluer l’exposition systémique à l’état d’équilibre du sotatercept en utilisant une dose échelonnée en fonction du poids par rapport à l’exposition en utilisant une dose basée sur le poids après l’administration de doses multiples (doses d’entretien) à l’état d’équilibre.
2. Évaluer l’innocuité et la tolérabilité du sotatercept sur 24 semaines de traitement
1. A sotatercept szisztémás expozíciójának értékelése súlysávos adagolás esetén a súlyalapú adagolás esetén tapasztalt expozícióhoz képest az első dózis alkalmazása után.

1. Évaluer l’exposition systémique au sotatercept en utilisant une dose échelonnée en fonction du poids par rapport à l’exposition en utilisant une dose basée sur le poids après l’administration de la dose initiale.

1. Ocena ogólnoustrojowej ekspozycji na sotatercept przy zastosowaniu dawkowania opartego na masie ciała w stosunku do ekspozycji przy zastosowaniu dawkowania opartego na masie ciała po podaniu dawki początkowej.

1. Evaluar la exposición sistémica en el estado de equilibrio de sotatercept mediante la administración de dosis basada en rangos de peso en relación con la exposición, mediante la administración de dosis basada en el peso después de la administración de dosis inicial

1. Evaluatie van de systemische blootstelling aan sotatercept bij een dosering op basis van een gewichtsbereik in vergelijking met een dosering op basis van een gewicht na toediening van een initiële dosis.

enrollment.display: USDM Eligibility Criteria for A Phase 2, Multicenter, Single-blinded, Randomized Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics and Safety of Sotatercept (MK-7962) Administered Using Either a Weight-based or Weight-banded Approach in Participants With Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) on Standard of Care

arm.name: Weight-based sotatercept dosing
arm.description: Participants will receive sotatercept via subcutaneous (SC) injection every 3 weeks at an initial dose of 0.3 mg/kg and then at a maintenance dose of 0.7 mg/kg using a weight-based method during a 24-week treatment period. Participants will continue to take their background PAH therapy during the study.

arm.name: Weight-banded sotatercept dosing
arm.description: Participants will receive sotatercept via SC injection every 3 weeks at an initial dose of up to 45 mg and then at a maintenance dose of up to 90 mg using a weight-banded method during a 24-week treatment period. Participants will continue to take their background PAH therapy during the study.

resource.name: USDM Eligibility Criteria for A Phase 2, Multicenter, Single-blinded, Randomized Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics and Safety of Sotatercept (MK-7962) Administered Using Either a Weight-based or Weight-banded Approach in Participants With Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) on Standard of Care

extension.valueMarkdown:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Has documented diagnostic Right Heart Catheterization, with the diagnosis of World Health Organization (WHO) Pulmonary Atrial Hypertension (PAH) Group 1 in any of the following subtypes: Idiopathic PAH, Heritable PAH, Drug/toxin-induced PAH, PAH associated with connective tissue disease, PAH associated with simple, congenital systemic-to-pulmonary shunts at least 1 year following repair
2. Has systemic PAH classified as WHO Functional Class II or III

Exclusion criteria:

1. Has weight of <35kg
2. Has diagnosis of Pulmonary Hypertension WHO Groups 2, 3, 4, or 5
3. Has a diagnosis of the following PAH Group 1 subtypes: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)-associated PAH, PAH associated with portal hypertension, Exclusion in PAH Group 1 also includes: schistosomiasis-associated PAH, pulmonary veno occlusive disease and pulmonary capillary hemangiomatosis
4. Has uncontrolled systemic hypertension
5. Has a history of pneumonectomy
6. Has a history of known pericardial constriction
7. Has a history of restrictive cardiomyopathy
8. Has a history of atrial septostomy (within 180 days prior to study start)
9. Has personal or family history of long QT syndrome
10. Has history of coronary artery disease (myocardial infarction, percutaneous coronary intervention, coronary artery bypass, graft surgery, or cardiac anginal chest pain) (within 6 months prior to study start)
11. Has a cerebrovascular accident (within 3 months prior to study start)
12. Has significant (>2+ regurgitation) mitral regurgitation or aortic regurgitation valvular disease
13. Has untreated more than mild obstructive sleep apnea
14. Has known malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 5 years
15. Has recently started (within 12 months prior to study start) or has plans to start weight loss medication or enter a weight loss program during the study period
16. Has a previous (within 3 years) or planned (during the study) obesity treatment with surgery or a weight-loss device
